terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Demo only: mandates, offers, stances and salts are published so every on-chain hash can be recomputed. A real agent never discloses them.

separation.note: Three OS processes on one machine. Each agent process loaded only its own key and limit; the relay process never read the agents' keys and reached them over HTTP on 127.0.0.1.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 3800, 200 below the reference, 500 below its limit.
buyer.note: Plan (3 rounds): R1 open 3800, i.e. 200 below the 4000 reference, keeping 500 of room under the 4300 limit. Seller has 6 reviews at 4.38 (3 trusted) — credible but not dominant, so I expect them to sit near/above reference. R2: if no cross, step up to ~4000 (reference) and hold a firm tone; if it crossed at 3800 we already paid ≤3800, excellent. R3: final step to at most 4150–4200, never 4300 — going to the limit publishes my principal's ceiling and weakens future talks. Prefer a deal at ≤4150 o

seller.explanation: Opened at 4700, 700 above the reference, 600 above its limit.
seller.note:
PLAN (seller, floor 4100, ref 4000, settlement = midpoint so payoff rises with my ask if it crosses; non-crossing numbers stay private, so high probes are free information).
R1: 4700 (+700 over ref) — probe the buyer's ceiling. Buyer agentId 2084, 4.70/6 reviews, 3 trusted: competent, likely starts low and walks numbers up, so a R1 cross is unlikely but pays big if it happens.
R2: if no cross -> 4400. If crossed, done.
R3: if still no cross -> 4180 (keeps 80 of floor hidden). Only drop toward 41
